active_parameter_count_definition: materialized GPT parameters; never substitute latent trainable count

affine_subspace_parameterization.base_distribution: frozen Gaussian residual-projection initialization with std 0.02/sqrt(2*n_layer)
affine_subspace_parameterization.fixed_storage_caveat: preserves trainable-coordinate compression but stores one frozen dense c_proj base per layer

candidate_learning_rate_resolution: reuse the selected 124m full-attention multiplier 1.00 learning rate to isolate the added mlp.c_proj target
candidate_scope: accepted full-attention replacement plus mlp.c_proj parameterized as a frozen GPT-initialized dense base and a zero-initialized fixed BlockFHT delta; no learned basis, LoRA adapter, or trainable dense residual
eg_flops_accounting: EGTime is primary. EG_FLOPs must include BlockFHT decode/materialization, cache prepare/flush, and generated-weight gradient mapping, or be labelled nominal.
eval_batch_shape_policy: shared b16 evaluation independent of rung training microbatch; ordered fixed train/val windows and token budget must match the attention-only control
fixed_eval_index_runtime_digest: record train.py rng_eval_metadata.fixed_eval_indices_sha256 before launch; candidate and attention-only control must match
instability_policy: hard reject NaN, Inf, divergence, or failed terminal evaluation
ladder_interpretation: progressive target-replacement screen; this is not a fitted MLP scaling ladder

manifold_study.evidence: Each c_fc/c_proj path is locally two-PC at 95 percent energy, but terminal displacements and temporal PC directions are high matrix rank; layer tangents are raw-coordinate orthogonal, while paired hidden-channel displacement norms are strongly correlated.
manifold_study.scope_limit: One Muon optimizer trajectory is not the intrinsic dimension of the global solution manifold.

monitoring_policy: short preflight and training run are polled directly; no watchdog, callback, queue heartbeat, or PRO6 execution

muon_latent_chart.generator_forward: unchanged BlockFHT map after row-major flattening; the 2D shape changes optimizer geometry only

operator_override.reason: all selected attention-only 20TPP runs are launched and the user required idle Y400 capacity to advance to MLP work

optimizer_assignment_expected: matrix-shaped zero-initialized c_proj BlockFHT latents are Muon-owned; attention latents use the registered AdamW fallback; frozen dense base buffers are not optimized

phase_drift_evidence.interpretation: retain a full-distribution initialization point while testing whether the compact fixed chart can express the useful local displacement

practical_equivalence_policy: compare against the matched attention-only control on identical fixed evaluation windows; do not promote without terminal evidence
prelaunch_provenance_requirements: record commit, source/config/dataset/fixed-eval hashes, literal command, exact host-local MFU certificate, status, log, and terminal checkpoint

preregistered_decision_rule.directional_only: stable candidate improves on 5.7395 but remains above the +0.1000 attention-control gap
preregistered_decision_rule.primary_metric: terminal fixed-window validation cross entropy at update 238
preregistered_decision_rule.reject: candidate ties or regresses versus 5.7395, is unstable, or does not complete
preregistered_decision_rule.success: stable candidate finishes at or below 5.5918 CE, within +0.1000 of the accepted attention-only control

recipe_resolution_dependency: exact 41-snapshot dense c_fc/c_proj tangent analysis found high local low-rank energy but severe phase-to-phase rotation and weak capture by one origin-anchored fixed subspace
schedule_rounding: ceil(planned_tokens / tokens_per_iter); lr decay and terminal eval occur at max_iters
screen_only_resolution: one 124M/0.5TPP causal run after a foreground-polled 20-percent-MFU qualification
selection_endpoint: terminal fixed-window validation CE versus the exact attention-only and Muon-chart generated-c_proj controls
terminal_eval_protocol: evaluate at max_iters even when it is off periodic cadence
